segments.name: Electrical Americas
segments.description: Makes electrical power management products and systems for data center, commercial, residential and industrial customers in the Americas.
segments.evidence: Organic sales increased 8% in 2025 due to strength in data center end-markets in the Electrical Americas and Electrical Global business segments

segments.name: Electrical Global
segments.description: Serves data center, utility, machine building and residential customers worldwide with electrical products, systems and services.
segments.evidence: Additionally, the increase in organic sales in 2025 was due to strength in the Asia Pacific and European regions and in the Global Energy Infrastructure Solutions (GEIS) business.

segments.name: Aerospace
segments.description: Supplies aerospace technologies, aftermarket support and electronic controls to commercial, military and space aircraft customers.
segments.evidence: Eaton's industry-leading portfolio of aerospace technologies elevates aircraft efficiency, safety and performance for customers across the commercial, military and space markets.

segments.name: Vehicle
segments.description: Provides vehicle technologies and internal combustion engine solutions to automotive, commercial vehicle, aftermarket and off-road customers.
segments.evidence: Eaton provides differentiated technologies that improve safety, efficiency, and performance for customers in the automotive, commercial vehicle, aftermarket and off-road segments.

segments.name: eMobility
segments.description: Supplies electrified vehicle technologies to a large original equipment manufacturer of vehicles and related components.
segments.evidence: Eaton announced its intention to pursue a spin-off of its Mobility business, which consists of its Vehicle and eMobility operating segments, into an independent, publicly traded company.

revenueModel.text: Customers in data center, utility, industrial, commercial, residential, aerospace and mobility markets pay Eaton for power management products, systems and services.
revenueModel.evidence: We make products for the data center, utility, industrial, commercial, machine building, residential, aerospace and mobility markets.

changes.text: In 2026 Eaton re-segmented its reportable operating segments, creating Mobility from the legacy Vehicle and eMobility segments.
changes.evidence: During the first quarter of 2026, Eaton re-segmented certain reportable operating segments due to a reorganization of the Company's businesses.

changes.text: In 2026 Eaton announced its intention to spin off its Mobility business into a separate publicly traded company.
